minimumSafeProcessChanges.change: Require repair closure accounting for each finding, including requested additions.
minimumSafeProcessChanges.details: Resolve every requested change to exact before/after tuples and added subject/predicate/evidence. Reject or hold proposals whose actions remain only in explanatory prose. A related-event consistency checklist should include all supplied participants/hints, but must not auto-copy dates or broaden a repair outside authorized scope. Production validation and a fresh independent full review remain mandatory.

minimumSafeProcessChanges.change: Require a Chinese anchor for every narrowing or newly introduced endpoint.

minimumSafeProcessChanges.change: Deterministically check retained unresolved chronology before approval assembly.
minimumSafeProcessChanges.details: Candidate3 has181 claims containing unresolved:true, up from102 and146. recommendedFirstIntervention.type: Scheduling and future-review instruction clarification; no live-input/code change
recommendedFirstIntervention.action: After live jobs drain, preserve complete negative/blocked reports. Before another fresh full-chapter re-audit, inspect unresolved-container inventory and perform targeted source research or retain research holds. Candidates with unresolved:true cannot possibly gain approval under unchanged validator; do not repeatedly spend full coverage re-audits expecting approval.
recommendedFirstIntervention.futureSealedReviewClarification: When an owned item contains unresolved:true in a temporal container, a no-finding supported approval is structurally invalid. Return a substantive research-blocked check and actionable finding unless primary research actually resolves it; never merely mark supported because the uncertainty is honestly represented.
recommendedFirstIntervention.followupEngineering: For future repair plans only, a compact closure receipt mapping immutable finding hashes to exact affected/added tuples can catch unimplemented additions such as p311 death. Test missing additions, compound findings, positional renumbering, unchanged dates with semantic rationale, and research holds. Do not change retained seals or assume matching an item ID proves semantic closure.
recommendedFirstIntervention.avoid: Do not implement automatic source chronology inference, blindly replace all unresolved rows with undatedSourceAttestation, clear uncertainty flags, or skip independent complete coverage.
